notes: Starting cards as posted under 'Start ( 9 )': the Objective ('HDADTJ'), Epic Duel, Executor: Meditation Chamber, Executor: Holotheatre, 'Visage', No Escape, Imperial Arrest Order ('IAO'), Mobilization Points ('Mobil Points') and Prepared Defenses; these count toward the 60 (total 60 as published). Several Effects start, so no single starting Effect is set.

Starting 'Visage' dested Visage Of The Emperor (the Effect Hunt Down deploys at start; the starship Visage would not start). 'Visage of the Emperor' is also listed under Effects, so the deck lists two copies of this unique Effect as published.
'DS DB' dested Death Star: Docking Bay 327 ('DS' is the first Death Star; the strategy's 'Death Star Docking Bay' could also mean Death Star II: Docking Bay).

Posted 'Choke Vader' dested Darth Vader, Dark Lord Of The Sith; 'Vader w/ Saber' Darth Vader With Lightsaber; 'Dengar w/ Gun' Dengar With Blaster Carbine; 'Fett in Ride' Boba Fett In Slave I; 'Bus' Bossk In Hound's Tooth; 'Dreadnaught' Dreadnaught-Class Heavy Cruiser; 'Hell2Pay' There'll Be Hell To Pay; 'CBHYBCoward' the Special Edition Effect Come Here You Big Coward; 'Put All Sections on the Alert' Put All Sections On Alert; 'Mara Jade Stick' Mara Jade's Lightsaber.
Oppressive Enforcement is the Special Edition Effect in November 2000 (not the Reflections III Defensive Shield).
Section header 'Locs ( 4 )' is not a card.
